follow-up time: From Cesarean section to 6 weeks postpartum for the delayed hysterectomy group
exposure: Treatment modality (immediate hysterectomy, delayed hysterectomy, fertility-sparing surgery)
cohort: 21 patients with suspected placenta percreta at an academic tertiary care institution between 2005 and 2014
finding: A multidisciplinary strategy involving immediate or delayed hysterectomy with or without interventional radiology procedures for placenta percreta appears feasible, but further research is needed to compare its effectiveness to cesarean hysterectomy.
